text: Hiya, I'm minding my baby brother, he's 4 months, and me mam and dad are out. He's 37.9 and he keeps pulling at his ear, I'm really scared something's wrong with him. He's wide awake now, looking around and babbling at me and the telly, so he is. He has a few little red bumps on his arms too but that's only the midges, he was out the garden in the pram all day and we saw them going at him, they're just bites. I'm sorry, I didn't know who else to ask. Do I need to ring them to come home?
